doctor.title: Anya environment check
doctor.terminal.ssh_target: the desktop terminal that will start Anya
doctor.unhealthy: Result: fix the items above, then start Anya again.
doctor.engine.name: Speech engine
doctor.engine.unknown.fix: Pick an engine in the settings window, or set [voice] engine in {config}.
doctor.engine.invalid_value: {engine}: {field} has a value it cannot use
doctor.engine.fix: Fill in the engine's settings in the settings window, or under [voice.engine_configs] in {config}.
doctor.clipboard_tool.name: Clipboard tool
doctor.clipboard_tool.fix: Install the {package} package so {tool} is on PATH.
doctor.paste_keys.name: Pasting into the focused field
doctor.paste_keys.not_granted: Accessibility permission is off; text is copied but not pasted
doctor.paste_keys.not_granted.fix: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, turn on {terminal}, then restart Anya.
doctor.paste_keys.wtype: wtype at {path} (if pasting does nothing, grant write access to /dev/uinput as a fallback)
doctor.paste_keys.denied: wtype is not installed and /dev/uinput is not writable: {error}
doctor.paste_keys.denied.fix: Install wtype, or give your user write access to /dev/uinput with a udev rule and group.
doctor.paste_keys.kde_denied: KDE Plasma needs /dev/uinput (wtype does not work there), and it is not writable: {error}
doctor.paste_keys.kde_denied.fix: Run: sudo groupadd -f uinput; sudo usermod -aG uinput $USER; write /etc/udev/rules.d/70-uinput.rules containing KERNEL=="uinput", MODE="0660", GROUP="uinput", OPTIONS+="static_node=uinput"; then sudo modprobe uinput && sudo udevadm control --reload-rules && sudo udevadm trigger /dev/uinput, and log in again.
